meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在代码交付前跑一遍人工验收与质量审查,给出是否可提交的结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚完成一批工作,想在交付或发起 PR 前确认质量与风险都过关
copy.tagline_en: Run acceptance and quality review before shipping to confirm readiness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've finished a batch of work and want quality and risk checked before handoff

howto.what: 实现完成后,它会先自己在真实界面上跑一遍手动 QA,再派一个 gate reviewer 审查目标、约束、代码质量、安全与遗漏的上下文,最后给出 QA 矩阵和通过或失败结论。
howto.when: 在提交 PR 交接之前,或你明确要求审查已完成的实现时接管。

say.text: 这次改动先帮我审一遍,我再去提 PR
say.note: 会先跑 QA,再派一个 gate reviewer 审查。

say.text: 实现做完了,跑一次门禁审查
say.note: 产出 QA 矩阵和通过/失败结论。

say.text: 对这个分支做发布前审查
say.note: QA 有失败行就直接报失败。

howto.what_en: After implementation, it runs manual QA on the real surface itself, then launches one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security and QA evidence, reporting a QA matrix with a pass or fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Use before a PR handoff, or when you explicitly ask it to review completed work.

say_en.text: Review this change before I hand off the PR
say_en.note: Runs QA first, then one gate reviewer.

say_en.text: The implementation is done - run a gate review
say_en.note: Produces a QA matrix and a verdict.

say_en.text: Do a pre-release review of this branch
say_en.note: Any failing QA row ends it with a fail.
